root_cause: This is a recurrence (3rd occurrence) of a pre-existing, known bug (signature e746e8e11c0fe156) first identified on 2026-10-23 (run 40003582793, PR #38825), recurring again on 2026-11-16 (run 43897852365, PR #39833), and now recurring here on 2026-11-17. PR #38297 added ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices, which asserts via OV_EXPECT_THROW that BOTH get_plugin_outputs() (CPU) and calculate_refs() (TEMPLATE/interpreter reference) throw ov::Exception for out-of-range scatter indices (scatter_update.cpp:145-146). The CPU plugin correctly throws via its CPU_NODE_ASSERT bounds check, but calculate_refs() does not raise - the reference/interpreter evaluation path used for calculate_refs() apparently does not propagate the bounds-check exception from the shared reference implementation the same way the CPU plugin does. PR #39956 under investigation here only touches an NPU-plugin cmake file (src/plugins/intel_npu/cmake/download_compiler_libs.cmake) and has no relation to ScatterUpdate/CPU reference code; the failure surfaced purely because this merge-queue run rebases the PR onto the latest master, which still carries the unresolved reference-path gap from #38297.
reproduction_steps:
1. Checkout openvinotoolkit/openvino at or after the commit that merged PR #38297 (introducing ScatterUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices).
2. Build the ov_cpu_func_tests target.
3. Run: ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*smoke_ScatterUpdateGeneralPathOutOfRangeIndices*ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices*
4. Observe calculate_refs() does not raise ov::Exception while get_plugin_outputs() (CPU) does, failing the second OV_EXPECT_THROW at scatter_update.cpp:145.
recommended_actions: This is unrelated to PR #39956 (NPU cmake-only change); the PR can be safely rebased/re-merged once the pre-existing reference-path bug is fixed or the test is temporarily adjusted.

Fix the reference-path gap: confirm the bounds check in src/core/reference/include/openvino/reference/scatter_update.hpp actually fires for the smoke_ScatterUpdateGeneralPathOutOfRangeIndices params (indices {0, 100000} on an {8,4} tensor, axis 0), and that SubgraphBaseTest::calculate_refs() does not swallow or convert the thrown exception before it reaches OV_EXPECT_THROW.

As a stop-gap to unblock the merge queue, consider temporarily skipping the 4 failing ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices/GeneralPathOutOfRangeIndices parametrized cases via skip_tests_config until the reference-path fix lands.

Escalate urgently to the CPU plugin / test-infra owners of PR #38297 since this is now its 3rd recorded recurrence in the merge queue with no fix yet landed, and each recurrence blocks an unrelated PR.
prevention_strategies: When a new error-condition test asserts both plugin and reference-computation throw (OV_EXPECT_THROW on both get_plugin_outputs() and calculate_refs()), CI should fail fast and be triaged immediately rather than allowed to recur across multiple unrelated PRs' merge-queue runs; add a dedicated, isolated CI check for new error-condition test additions that runs calculate_refs() independently to catch this class of gap before merge. Given this is now a 3rd recurrence, consider disabling the 4 known-bad parametrized cases immediately to stop blocking the merge queue.
